content.body:
# Beginner's Vegetable Garden Plan

This note serves as the central plan for starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard, targeting a 4x8 feet raised bed with a focus on beginner-friendly vegetables and manageable steps for completion by early May.

## Garden Layout

Planning a raised bed of 4 feet by 8 feet in a backyard location that receives about 6 hours of sunlight daily. Need to confirm if 6 hours of sunlight is sufficient for most vegetables. Research ideal dimensions for beginner raised beds.

## Supplies Needed

- [ ] Soil
- [ ] Containers or raised bed materials (for 4x8 feet bed)
- [ ] Seeds (tomatoes, lettuce, others TBD)
- [ ] Basic gardening tools
- [ ] Watering system (consider simple drip irrigation)
- [ ] Fencing or natural pest deterrents (to protect against rabbits and other pests)

## Planting Schedule

Target planting completion by early May. Specific planting calendar to be detailed in [[Vegetable Planting Calendar]].

## Additional Considerations

- Research companion planting (e.g., basil near tomatoes for mutual benefit).
- Address pest control with a preference for natural deterrents over chemicals.
- Confirm suitability of vegetables for zone 7b climate.
